tools.name: search_stations
tools.description: Free. Resolve a station or city name to a stop_id. A bare city name resolves to that city's main rail hub only when exactly one candidate exists; the answer then carries a 'resolution' object naming the rule, the chosen station and the rejected alternatives. Use the returned stop_id as 'to' in plan_

tools.name: departures
tools.description: Free. Upcoming departures at a stop_id, with trip_id, line, scheduled/actual time and current delay. Use trip_id as 'trip_id' in plan_transfer for the train the traveller is already on.
